Temperature Converter

Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin and Rankine with live sync.

Type in any field — the other three update instantly. Absolute zero is −273.15 °C.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a temperature into any one of the four fields.
  2. The other three units update instantly as you type.
  3. Clear the field to reset all four values.
  4. Values below absolute zero (−273.15 °C) are flagged as physically impossible.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the formula for Celsius to Fahrenheit?

Multiply Celsius by 9/5 and add 32. For example, 20 °C × 9/5 + 32 = 68 °F.

How do Kelvin and Rankine relate to each other?

Both scales start at absolute zero. Rankine = Kelvin × 9/5, so 273.15 K equals 491.67 °R.

Can I enter a temperature below absolute zero?

The converter still does the math, but it warns you: nothing can be colder than −273.15 °C (0 K / 0 °R).
